newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - Piltel raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Piltel raised to buy.

text.p: Angping & Associates Securities Inc said on Wednesday it upgraded Pilipino Telephone Corp from a sell rating to a long-term buy due to the company's implementation of measures to solve its cloning and collection problems.

The broker said in a report that based on a recent company visit, it has found that the cellular phone company has strengthened its customer service, set up anti-cloning devices and established 23 new collection centers.
Cloning refers to the fradulent charging of telephone bills to unsuspecting subscribers.

"We have upgraded our position for Piltel from a sell to a long-term buy since the company's efforts will definitely bear fruit even though it might take a while," said Angping analyst Alexis Cabel. Piltel stock was up 25 centavos to 16.50 pesos.
The launching of the company's digital service in September will initially target 10,000 to 20,000 subscribers, Cabel added.
Cabel said that assuming 15,000 new non-delinquent subscribers monthly and a provision of 10 percent of operating revenues for doubtful accounts, Piltel can achieve 37 percent growth this year.
"The building process will take time and quarterly results are still needed to re-affirm Piltel's possible recovery story," said Cabel.
Piltel's chief finance officer Juan Velasquez last week said he expects the company to register flat profits this year as it grapples with the cloning problem.
